metadata.description: Standalone marketplace for the tamirs-superpowers plugin. Lets Claude Code install straight from this repo without the tamirs-marketplace catalog.

plugins.name: tamirs-superpowers
plugins.description: 29 bundled skills, 10 specialist agents, smart worktree hooks, statusline, and MCP server stubs — plan, implement, review, debug, multi-agent setup, and audit code from one plugin.

plugins.name: tamirs-superpowers-guard
plugins.description: In-process guard for tamirs-superpowers: holds a destructive shell command (force push, rm -rf, git reset --hard, ...) until you answer Proceed or Cancel, and refuses a file write in the main checkout while an orchestration objective is active. Companion to the core plugin; Claude Code and Claude Desktop only.
